answer: A newcomer posts a refundable 320 POA bond locked 75 days, so one fake identity costs 320 POA plus ten real jobs no farm can run in parallel. Its first ten jobs climb a trellis of paid work, one client at a time, so copied history shows at once. A knoll mark is stamped on every verified job, and only the paying client can mint it. Verified jobs enter a crystal record buyers read before paying, and a forged entry burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
